bin/lark-cli.content:
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$FAKE_LARK_LOG"
case "$1 $2" in
  "docs +update")
    cat > "$FAKE_TRACE_CONTENT"
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true}'
    ;;
  "whoami --as")
    printf '%s\n' '{"identity":"user","available":true,"tokenStatus":"ready","onBehalfOf":{"openId":"ou_contract"}}'
    ;;
  "base +record-list")
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true,"data":{"items":[]}}'
    ;;
  "base +record-upsert")
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true,"data":{"record":{"record_id":"rec_contract"}}}'
    ;;
  "base +record-get")
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true,"data":{"record":{"record_id":"rec_contract","fields":{"trace_key":"docx:TraceDocument"}}}}'
    ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' "unexpected command: $*" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
